transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess... I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, keep up with people. Now I don’t really do any of that. I don’t call people back.

Some days I’m just sitting in my rental for hours, and I know there are things I need to do, but I can’t make myself start. That’s mostly why I’m here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. I’m not feeling good, but it’s more like I’m just... flat, or stuck. I’m not crying all the time or anything. I just don’t have much in me lately.
Do you still enjoy things when you do them?

Not really. Even if I make myself pick up the guitar or think about going for a hike, it doesn’t feel the same. Most of the time I don’t even get that far. I just sit there knowing I should do something, call someone back, anything, and I can’t seem to start.
Did this start after a major stress or life change?
Yeah. It was after my divorce, when I moved into a smaller rental place. That was about a year and two months ago. Since then, things have just been kind of unraveling.
Are you still feeling this way now?

Yes. It’s still going on. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I stopped hiking, stopped coaching, hardly play guitar, and I don’t call people back. Some days I’m just sitting in that small rental for hours, knowing there are things I need to do, but I can’t get myself to start.
Have you felt this flat or stuck nearly every day for at least two weeks at a time?

Yeah. It’s been like that most days, for way longer than two weeks. I just don’t feel like myself. I stopped doing the things I used to do—hiking, coaching, playing guitar—and I don’t really call people back. Some days I just sit there in the rental for hours, knowing I need to do things, and I can’t get myself to start.
Have you been feeling sad or hopeless?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad exactly. Hopeless… maybe at times, but mostly it’s more like I’m just stuck and worn down. Like things don’t really move forward.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had moments where I feel worn out and like I don’t see a way forward, but… I don’t know if that’s the same as thinking life isn’t worth living.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I don’t know. I’ve felt really worn down, but I’m not sure I’ve thought of it exactly like being better off dead. It’s hard to separate sometimes.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I don’t think I can say that clearly. I’ve felt worn out and stuck, but “better off dead” isn’t really a thought I can point to.
Has this been making it hard for you to function day to day?

Yeah. It’s been hard. I got suspended from my protective service job after a routine patrol where I scared some staff and people nearby. Since then I’ve kind of pulled back from everything — coaching, volunteering, even people who used to rely on me. I’m not really functioning like I was.
Before the divorce, had you ever gone through another period like this?

No, not like this. Things really started unraveling after I moved into the smaller rental after the divorce — that was about a year and two months ago. Before that, I don’t remember having a stretch like this.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?
I don’t know. I haven’t really been paying close attention to it. I guess my eating’s been kind of irregular, but I can’t say for sure if my appetite has changed.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or empty most of the day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve felt off and worn down, but I can’t say it’s been depressed or empty most of the day. I haven’t been tracking it like that.
During the past two weeks, have you felt sad most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad most of the day nearly every day. I’ve had bad stretches, but I haven’t really been keeping track of it that way.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot?

Yeah… I have been on edge a lot. It’s because I’m pretty sure people have been watching what I do. For months now, the guys across from my rental, and some people at work, it feels like they’ve been tracking my patrol routes and testing my locks. I know that sounds extreme, but the same cars and little comments keep lining up too perfectly to be random.
Are you certain that people are watching and testing you?

Yes. I mean, I know how it sounds, but I’m certain. It’s been going on for months — the guys across from my rental, and some people at work. The same cars show up, comments get made that match my patrol routes, and it feels like they’re testing my locks. It lines up too much to be random.
When you feel less worn down or flat, do you still believe people are watching and testing you?

Yes. Even when I’m not feeling as worn down or flat, I still believe it. It’s been going on for months — the guys across from my rental, and some people at work. The same cars keep showing up, and the little comments line up with my patrol routes. It feels like they’re testing my locks. It just matches up too much to be random.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Yeah. Not like long conversations, but I hear these short, radio-like voices sometimes when my scanner is off. They’ll say things like someone’s inside or that I’m being watched. It’s clear enough that I go check. And sometimes at home I’ll see a shadow move past the hallway, even after I already cleared every room.
For at least one month, have you been hearing these voices?
Yes. It’s been more than a month — about four months now that I’ve been hearing the voices.
